text: Thabo's band is playing the Lexington on Friday. He's nervous because it's their first headline slot and half his family are coming down from Manchester, including his gran, who has never seen him play. I said I'd come and bring Jun. Doors are at seven, so we'll grab food beforehand somewhere nearby and head over together.
Uma has a flat viewing in Walthamstow sometime next week. If it goes well she wants to move by the end of the month.
Zeynep invited me to her housewarming on the 14th. She asked people not to bring flowers because her cat Pistachio eats them.
Remind me to text Paolo good luck the morning of his half marathon. It's Sunday, and he's been struggling with his knee.
Santiago and Lucy are hosting a dinner for their tenth anniversary in early March. Small, just close friends.
Samir's piano recital went really well apparently. His mum filmed the whole thing. Ask him to send me the video.

Katarzyna is moving to Edinburgh over the summer for a new job at the university. She's excited but hasn't found anywhere to live yet, and rents up there are apparently mad. She's flying up for a weekend of viewings sometime in May. I should ask her to send me the listings, I know a couple of the areas from when I lived there.
Joe's leaving party has been cancelled. His boss asked him to stay on another six months instead.
Reza is running a 10K next Saturday. His wife Anika is doing it too, her first one. I should send them both something the day before.
Pick up the keys from the letting agent on Thursday and book the van for the weekend after.
Cem plays five-a-side on Tuesdays and is obsessed with Galatasaray. Apparently he's been dropping hints about a signed shirt for his birthday.
Leon is in a play at the Old Vic in November, a small part but his first professional one. He said the dress rehearsal is the night before opening and he's dreading it.
Called Helen. She's finally exchanged on the house in Bristol! Completion is the end of the month and she wants everyone round for drinks a week after.
Sunil said his daughter Aditi has a dance competition in Birmingham this weekend. He's driving up that morning and back the next day.
Juan doesn't really drink, so for his birthday dinner on the 3rd, think of something other than wine.
Jack and his girlfriend are viewing two flats tomorrow, one in Clapham and one in Brixton. I must ask him how it went afterwards.

Idris got into the regional chess final! It's sometime in early December, in Leeds. His dad is apparently more nervous than he is and has been practising openings with him every evening. Idris himself seems pretty relaxed about it and mostly just wants to get it over with so he can go back to his football. Text him good luck the night before.
Aditi is throwing a surprise fortieth for her husband on the 22nd. Need to RSVP by Friday and don't forget to chip in for the present.
Tobi's moving back to Lagos at the end of the year. His mum isn't well and he wants to be closer. He sounded tired.
Kai's first gig with the new band was last night. Message him today to see how it went.

Lovely dinner with Natasha and Michael last night. They've just got a puppy called Biscuit, who chewed through my shoelace in about four minutes. They're moving to a place with a garden sometime in the spring, probably out towards Walthamstow. Natasha is also training for the Hackney Half in April and is worried about her ankle, which she twisted a couple of weeks ago.
Liam is captain of the cricket team now. Their cup final is the last Saturday in June.
Zoe has a callback for the musical on Wednesday. She was shaking just talking about it. Text her the night before, and again the next day to ask how it went.

Kwame's brother Cem is getting married in Accra in early April. Kwame is best man and giving a speech, and he is terrified of public speaking. The whole family is flying out the week before for the traditional ceremony, and they're staying on for a few days afterwards. He asked if I'd look over a draft of the speech once he's written it, so don't forget to do that.
Rana invited me to her book club's Christmas dinner. It's the second Friday of December. She's vegan, so I'll bring the dessert I made last year.
Chloe and Alina are doing a joint housewarming now that they've moved in together. Sometime the week after next, date to be confirmed.
Alina mentioned she's been collecting vintage vinyl for years, mostly Turkish psych and old jazz.
Need to sort the deposit for the new flat before the end of the week and give notice on the old one.
Thabo said the gig went brilliantly and someone from a label was there. They're meeting him sometime next week. Find out what happened.
Saw Uma yesterday. The Walthamstow flat fell through, but she's viewing another one on Saturday morning. She's really stressed about the whole thing.
Paolo's knee held up and he finished in under two hours! I should send congrats. He's celebrating at the pub afterwards, and I said I'd swing by.
Dr Haddad, Zeynep's mum, is retiring at the end of term. Zeynep is organising a dinner for her and asked if I'd help with the playlist.
Jun has tickets for the Arsenal match on the 2nd and offered me the spare. I'm going.
Samir Banerjee from work is running the Great North Run in September. He wants sponsors. Remind me to donate before payday.
Katarzyna, or Kasia as everyone calls her, found a flat in Leith! She moves in mid-August and her brother is driving her stuff up the day before.
Lucy's sister Chloe is having a baby in early March, the same week as their anniversary dinner. Lucy thinks they might have to move it.
Joe wasn't too upset about the leaving do. He said he'd rather have the money anyway.

Long chat with Reza about the 10K. He did it in 52 minutes and Anika beat him by three. They're already signed up for a half in the spring. He's also thinking of moving the family out to Kent over the summer, partly for the schools and partly because their landlord is selling. Ask him how the house hunt is going in a few weeks.
Cem's birthday is on the 9th. Order the shirt this week so it arrives in time.
Helen's drinks are on Saturday the 30th, from 7. Bring a bottle and something for the new garden.
Sunil's daughter came second at the dance competition! He was beaming. Must remember to congratulate her when I see them on Sunday.
Jack said the Clapham flat was perfect but they were outbid. He's a bit gutted. Viewing three more sometime next week.
Idris prefers to be called Idi by his friends. Worth knowing before the final.
Aditi's party went off without a hitch and her husband had no idea. She's sending photos later.
Talked to Tobi's sister Rana. She said he's flying out on the 18th and they're doing a send-off at his place the weekend before. I should go, and maybe get him something small for the flat out there.
Kai said the gig was a mess, the drummer didn't show and they had to cancel the second set. He's keen to do it properly at the end of the month.
Natasha starts a new job at the theatre in January. Michael is staying at home with the puppy for now.
Liam's team won the semi on Saturday. The final's in three weeks, and he's asked if I'd come along.

Zoe got the part! She rang me straight from the car park, practically screaming. Rehearsals start in early January and opening night is mid-February, at the Theatre Royal in Brighton. Her parents are coming down for the first night and she wants a group of us there the week after opening. I need to book tickets and sort a hotel before they sell out.
Kwame said the speech practice is going badly. He wants to run it past me sometime next week. Check in with him before then.

Rana's book club dinner has been called off because the host's flat flooded, which sounds awful. The poor woman has been living with her sister ever since. Rana is planning something smaller at her own place in January instead, probably the second weekend. She asked if I could still make the dessert, so I'll do the chocolate tart again.
Chloe said the housewarming is on the 8th now. Alina is cooking her famous dumplings. Don't forget to bring a plant, they love those.
Book the removal men for the 21st. Ask about packing boxes and whether they do a deep clean afterwards.
Michael Nguyen from the running club is doing his first triathlon in Windermere in early June. He's training every morning and says he hates swimming.

Got a long WhatsApp from Uncle Sunil. He's moving out of the big house in Leicester at the end of the summer and downsizing to a bungalow near the coast, somewhere near Skegness. He sounds sad about leaving it after thirty years but says the stairs are getting too much for his hip. Mum is going to help him sort through everything the weekend before. I need to call him sometime next week and offer to drive up and help with the loft.
Juan's partner Natasha said he's been really low since the band split up. He's playing solo at an open mic on Thursday. I should go and maybe take him for dinner after.
Zeynep's cat Pistachio went missing for two days but turned up this morning. She's relieved but exhausted.
Thabo's label meeting went well. They want to record an EP over the summer. Remind me to ask Thabo about the release date sometime in the autumn.

Housewarming at Helen's was lovely. Her neighbour Mrs Thomas plays in a brass band and invited us to their Christmas concert on the 19th. Helen's going, so I might tag along. Her son Kai is in it too, he's eleven and plays the cornet.
Quiet weekend planned. Clearing out the spare room and finally hanging the pictures.
